items.text: Esiana e lelo apa ootorrinyunye te yararoto

Kulo apa lelo tung'ana leilo kerenket ooetuo te yararoto eing'uaa lelo apa ootarayie Nebukadnesa olaiguanani le Babilon arik eenata te Babilon. Etorrinyunye ninche aapuonu Yerusalem o Yuda nelo ake pooki tung'ani enkang enye makewan.
Eetuo apa ninche tenebo Serubabel, o Yeshua, o Nehemia, o Seraia, o Reelaia, o Mordekai, o Balshan, o Mispar, o Bigfai, o Rehum, o Baana. Ena esiana oo ltung'ana loo Siraeli;
ore ilayiok le Parosh era esiana enye nkalifuni are o iip nabo o ntomoni naapishana oare.
Ore ilayiok le Shefatia, nera esiana enye, iip uni o ntomoni naapishana oare.
Ore ilayiok le Ara, nera esiana enye iip naapishana o ntomoni naapishana o imiet.
Ore ilayiok le Pahatmoab, aa taa ilayiok le Yeshua o Yoab, naa nkalifuni are o iip isiet o tomon oare.
Ore ilayiok le Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom o ong'uan.
Ore ilayiok le Satu naa iip naaudo o artam o imiet.
Ore ilayiok le Sakai, naa iip naapishana o ntomoni ile.
Ore ilayiok le Bani naa iip ile o artam o are.
Ore ilayiok le Bebai, naa iip ile o tikitam o okuni.
Ore ilayiok le Asgad naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o tikitam oare.
Ore ilayiok le Adonikam naa iip ile o ntomoni ile o ile.
Ore ilayiok le Bigfai naa nkalifuni are o onom o ile.
Ore ilayiok le Adin, naa iip ong'uan o onom o ong'uan.
Ore ilayiok le Ater, aa taa ile Hesekia, naa ntomoni naaudo o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Besai naa iip uni o tikitam o okuni.
Ore ilayiok le Yora naa, iip nabo o tomon oare.
Ore ilayiok le Hashum naa, iip are o tikitam o okuni.
Ore ilayiok le Gibar, naa ntomoni naaudo o imiet.
Ore ilayiok le Betlehem naa iip nabo o tikitam o okuni.
Ore iltung'ana le Netofia naa onom o ile.
Ore iltung'ana le Anatot naa iip nabo o tikitam o isiet.
Ore ilayiok le Asmafet naa artam oare.
Ore ilayiok le Kiriataim, Kefira o Beerot naa iip naapishana o artam o okuni.
Ore ilayiok le Rama o Geba, naa iip ile o tikitam o obo.
Ore iltung'ana le Mikmas, naa iip nabo o tikitam oare.
Ore iltung'ana le Betel o Ai naa iip are o tikitam o okuni.
Ore ilayiok le Nebo, naa onom o are.
Ore ilayiok le Makbish naa iip nabo o onom o ile.
Ore ilayiok le likae le Elam naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o onom o ong'uan.
Ore ilayiok le Harim, naa iip uni o tikitam.
Ore ilayiok le Lod, o Hadid, o Ono, naa iip naapishana o tikitam o imiet.
Ore ilayiok le Yeriko, naa iip uni o artam o imiet.
Ore ilayiok le Seena naa nkalifuni uni o iip ile o tomoni uni.
Ore ilapolosak lelo ayiok le Yedaia, le nkaji e Yeshua naa iip naaudo o ntomoni naapishana o okuni.
Ore ilayiok le Imer naa, enkalifu nabo o onom oare.
Ore ilayiok le Pashur, naa enkalifu nabo o iip are o artam oopishana.
Ore ilayiok le Harim, naa enkalifu nabo o tomon oopishana.
Ore Ilawi, lelo ayiok le Yeshua o Kadmiel, loo layiok le Hadafia, naa ntomoni naapishana o ong'uan.
Ore ilaranyak: lelo ayiok le Asaf, naa iip nabo o tikitam o isiet.

Ore lelo ayiok loo larripok loo nchomito; ilayiok le Shalum, o layiok le Ater, o layiok le Talmon o layiok le Akub, o layiok le Hatita, o layiok le Shobai, ore pooki tenebo, naa iip nabo o tomoni uni o oudo.
Ore ilaisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai, naa lelo aisiaayiak, o layiok le Siha, o layiok le Hafusa, o layiok le Taabaot,
o layiok le Keros, o layiok le Siaha, o layiok le Padon,
o layiok le Lebana, o layiok le Habaga, o layiok le Akub,
o layiok le Hagab, o layiok le Shamlai, o layiok le Hanan,
o layiok le Gidel, o layiok le Gahar, o layiok le Reaia,
o layiok le Resin, o layiok le Nekoda, o layiok le Gasam,
o layiok le Usa, o layiok le Pasea, o layiok le Besai,
o layiok le Asna, o layiok le Meumin, o layiok le Nefisim,
o layiok le Bakuk, o layiok le Hakufa, o layiok le Hahur,
o layiok le Baslut, o layiok le Mehida, o layiok le Harsha,
o layiok le Barkos, o layiok le Sisera, o layiok le Tema,
o layiok le Nesia, o layiok le Hatifa.
Ore too layiok loo sinkan le Solomon; naa ilayiok le Sotai, o layiok le Hosoferet, o layiok le Peruda,
o layiok le Yaala, o layiok le Darkon, o layiok le Gidel,
o layiok le Shefatia, o layiok le Hatil, o layiok le Pokeret-hasebaim, tenebo ilayiok le Ami.
Ore ilaisiaayiak pooki le nkaji e Nkai o layiok loo sinkan le Solomon naa iip uni o ntomoni naaudo oare.
Kulo apa lelo ooetuo eing'uaa Telmela, o Telhasha, o Kerub, o Adan, o Imer, hoo neitu apa ninche eidim aaibalie nkajijik oo loo menye anaa enetii ntipati enye, tenaa keitipat ninche Isirael:
lelo ayiok le Delaia, o layiok le Tobia, o layiok le Nekoda, nera pooki iip ile o onom oare.
Ore sii too layiok loo lapolosak, lelo ayiok le Barsilai, laa ninye apa oyama nabo oo ntoyie e Barsilai le Gilead, laa ninye apa eipotieki enkarna enye.
Eing'orutua kulo enkigeroto enye tiatua lelo ooigeroki too iishoritin, kake eitu etumi ninche teine, neaku eiwuang'ieki ninche te mpolosare aajo mesinya;
Enki 27.21
etiaaka ninche olbalusui nchere pee meinos ina daa sinyati oleng, meteleku ake tenaa ketii olapolosani oikilikuanishore Urim o Tumim.
Ore apa ina umata pooki tenebo naa nkalifuni artam o are o iip uni o ntomoni ile,
metii isinkan lenye o nkaisiaayiak enye, laa ore tenebo ninche naa, nkalifuni naapishana o iip uni o tomoni uni oopishana, neeta apa ninche ilaranyak loo lewa o ngoruo iip are.
Ore mbartan enye naa iip naapishana o tomoni uni o ile, ore inyumpui enye naa iip are o artam o imiet,
ore ntamesin enye naa iip ong'uan o tomoni uni o imiet, ore isirkon lenye naa nkalifuni ile o iip naapishana o tikitam.
Ore erubata oo lukuny oo lmareita, ina kata pee epuonu enkaji o Laitoriani te Yerusalem, neishoru nkishorot olpela te nkaraki enkaji e Nkai, pee esheti ninye te wueji enye;
te risioroto e nkidimata enye eishorutua ninche aapik olchumati le siaai nkiloi iip imiet e sahabu, o nkiloi nkalifuni are o ntomoni isiet e nkosholai, o lkilani iip nabo loo lapolosak.
1 Ilai 9.2
Neh 11.3

Ore ilapolosak o Lawi o embata oo ltung'ana nemany Yerusalem, o neemanita ninye, ore ilaranyak, o larripok loo nchomito, o laisiaayiak le nkaji e Nkai nebik too nkang'itie enye, ore Isiraeli pooki nebik too nkang'itie enye.
